test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word).

Germ : Disease : : War : _______
solution:
**Logic :** Term : Cause

So,

__
 
• **Germs** causes **diseases**.

Similarly,

 
• **War** causes **destruction**.

Hence, **"****Destruction"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Destruction → One of the reason of destruction can be war.
 
• Bomb → It is a destructive weapon which can be used in a war.
 
• Country → War can lead to suffering or damage of a country.
 
• Gun → It is a weapon which can be used in a war.
